business_summary: Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells special purpose vehicles, environmental equipment and systems, and car parking systems in Japan. The company offers vehicles for the construction sector, including dump, sprinkler, and concrete mixer trucks; piston type, squeeze type, stationary, high pressure and large capacity piston concrete pumps; and stationary mortar pumps. It also provides vehicles for the logistics and environmental sectors, such as tailgate lifters; tank, single car carrier, press refuse, mechanical/hydraulic operation refuse, heavy duty refuse, and container carrier trucks; and steel cargo bodies. In addition, the company offers environmental equipment and systems comprising pulverizers for crushing domestic and industrial wastes; and reuse, derived, and fuel (RDF) system, a solid fuel made from flammable garbage used as heat energy for hot-water supply, heating and cooling, and power generation. Further, it provides multistory car parking systems, including loading and unloading pit type, loading and unloading transverse pit type, and loading and unloading transverse ground type parking systems. Further, the company provides multistory parking systems, such as loading and unloading pit type, loading and unloading transverse pit type, and loading and unloading transverse ground type parking systems; and real estate rental services. The company was formerly known as Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kikai Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co.,Ltd. in April 1971. Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 극동해하쓰공업(주) 일본에서는 특수 목적 차량, 환경 장비 및 시스템, 주차 시스템을 제조 및 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 덤프, 스프링클러, 콘크리트 믹서 트럭 등 건설 ​​부문에 차량을 제공합니다. 피스톤형, 스퀴즈형, 고정식, 고압 및 대용량 피스톤 콘크리트 펌프; 고정식 모르타르 펌프. 또한 테일게이트 리프터와 같은 물류 및 환경 부문에 차량을 제공합니다. 탱크, 단일 자동차 운반선, 프레스 쓰레기, 기계/유압 작동 쓰레기, 대형 쓰레기 및 컨테이너 운반 트럭; 그리고 강철 화물 몸체. 또한 회사는 가정 및 산업 폐기물 분쇄용 분쇄기로 구성된 환경 장비 및 시스템을 제공합니다. 가연성 쓰레기를 원료로 한 고체연료인 RDF(Reuse, Derivative, Fuel) 시스템은 온수 공급, 냉난방, 발전용 열에너지로 사용됩니다. 또한, 승하차 피트형, 승하차 횡 피트형, 승하차 횡 지상형 주차 시스템을 포함한 다층 주차 시스템을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 다층 주차 시스템을 제공합니다.
